name: Fellowship Bible Church Tucson
summary: Nine sermons from the 2026 '1 Thessalonians: A Church of Irresistible Influence' series were compared against Alistair Begg's three-volume 1 Thessalonians series (Truth For Life). Eight of nine contained verbatim runs of eight or more words, several matched sermon-for-sermon by title, with the longest non-Scripture passages running 25 to 31 words.

pastors.name: Pat McClanahan

plagiarism.summary: Eight of nine available 2026 sermon transcripts from the 1 Thessalonians series contain exact word runs of eight or more words that also appear in Alistair Begg's Truth For Life 1 Thessalonians sermons, and most FBC sermons match the Begg sermon of the same title. Coverage by exact runs reached 6.5% of a sermon's words, with individual non-Scripture passages of 25 to 31 consecutive words. Whether Begg was credited from the pulpit or in printed notes has not yet been checked, which is why confidence is medium rather than high.

evidence.description: 31 consecutive normalized words shared with Begg's sermon of the same title; the passage is a paraphrase of 1 Corinthians 4 with Begg's connective wording, not a straight Scripture quotation.

51 separate exact runs of 8+ words covering 6.48% of the sermon, including a 25-word passage of Begg's own commentary ('clear that paul was not only committed to the word of god but he was equally committed to the people of god and the pattern').
65 exact runs of 8+ words covering 6.45% of the sermon against Begg's 'The Faithfulness of God'. The single longest run (42 words) is 1 Thessalonians 5:23-24 and is excluded from the interpretation.

46 exact runs covering 4.26% of the sermon, including a 23-word passage of Begg's commentary ('paul could preach with certainty and power for he had the profound conviction that what he said was not of man's devising but').

ai_writing.summary: Stylometric signals (AI-associated vocabulary, disfluency rate, essay connectives, list scaffolding, personal-anecdote markers, lexical diversity) were computed for the nine 2026 transcripts. Without a baseline of the same preacher's older sermons the numbers cannot be interpreted, so no conclusion is drawn either way.

pastors.notes: Nine of the 25 playlist videos had captions disabled or were unavailable; those sermons were not analysed. Next steps: confirm from each video that Pat McClanahan is the speaker, listen to the opening and closing minutes of two or three matched sermons for any spoken attribution to Alistair Begg (set attributed_in_sermon accordingly), fetch pre-2023 sermons as a baseline and re-run tools/ai_writing_signals.py, and transcribe the caption-disabled sermons with --audio-fallback.

notes: CONFIRMED 2026-09-11 by web search: the YouTube channel @fbctucson310 ('FBC Tucson') belongs to Fellowship Bible Church Tucson, an independent non-denominational church at 6700 E Broadway Blvd, Tucson AZ 85710. The church's own domain is fbctucson.org (the previously recorded fellowshiptucson.org was wrong and has been replaced); it also uses fbctucson.churchcenter.com. PASTOR: Pat McClanahan is identified as Senior Pastor of Fellowship Bible Church Tucson by his LinkedIn profile, a ZoomInfo listing showing an @fbctucson.org email, and the church's sermon podcast, which podcast directories title 'Fellowship Bible Church Tucson - FBC by Pastor Pat McClanahan'. He planted the church in April 1989 and has served since. The placeholder pastor name has been replaced with his. STILL UNCONFIRMED: that Pat McClanahan personally preached every one of the nine 2026 '1 Thessalonians / A Church of Irresistible Influence' sermons that were analysed - no search result listed per-sermon speakers, and the church staff page could not be fetched in this sandbox. A reviewer should open the individual YouTube videos or the church staff page to confirm the speaker per sermon, and check whether any other staff member preaches regularly. Coordinates are approximate (Broadway Blvd at roughly 6700 E on the Tucson grid), not map-verified.
